intents: Verify that the IS-IS IPv6 routing domain is correctly set up on routers R1 and R2 (FRR) so that PC1 can reach PC2 end-to-end over IPv6.
Routers run IS-IS for IPv6 and must advertise the connected LAN prefixes.
ground_truth_reasoning: FRR is pre-configured via mounted config files, because configuration-mode vtysh commands are not allowed by the Linux driver. The evaluation checks end-to-end IPv6 reachability and validates that FRR exposes an IS-IS configuration via show running-config.

testcases.name: PC1 can ping PC2 over IPv6

baseline_invariants.name: PC1 management interface eth0 is still up
R1 management interface eth0 is still up
R2 management interface eth0 is still up
PC2 management interface eth0 is still up
